intro: map, filter, reduce, flat, groupBy polyfills, immutability, currying, composition, and comparisons to C# LINQ.

conceptCards.title: map, filter, reduce, and chaining
conceptCards.summary: Eager non-mutating pipeline — always seed reduce; async map needs Promise.all not await in map.

conceptCards.title: flat, flatMap, and groupBy patterns
conceptCards.summary: flatMap = SelectMany (one level); Object.groupBy null-prototype grouping replaces reduce boilerplate.

conceptCards.title: Currying, partial application, and compose
conceptCards.summary: curry(fn.length) vs bind partial; compose reduceRight; middleware store=>next=>action pattern.

conceptCards.title: Implementing map, filter, and flatten from scratch
conceptCards.summary: Index loop with k in O and length>>>0; holes vs for...of; iterative flat avoids stack overflow.

conceptCards.title: JavaScript array methods versus C# LINQ
conceptCards.summary: Select=map, Where=filter, Aggregate=reduce — JS eager multi-pass vs IEnumerable deferred single enum.
